title: expand_url_template missing test for unmatched '{'
description: expand_url_template handles unmatched '{' via the ok_or_else branch (returns ClientError::InvalidSession). This is tested for the 'unknown variable' case but not for the 'no closing }' case. A test like expand_url_template("https://example.com/{unclosed", &[]) should return Err(InvalidSession) with a message about unmatched '{'. Without this test the unmatched-brace path is dead from a testing standpoint.
